name: The Night Watch
summary: In eastern Raven Hill, The Night Watch sends for help as Darkshire faces the undead. Commander Althea Ebonlocke calls on travelers to enter the crypts and destroy the plague spreaders while her guards defend the town. This is the last chapter in the guard’s direct fight against the undead overrun.

sections.title: A Desperate Frontier
sections.body: Darkshire stands nearly alone, with no soldiers from Stormwind to rely on. Its civilian militia, The Night Watch, must hold the town. Commander Althea Ebonlocke has few guards to spare, and she uses them to protect the crossroads, the town’s edge, and the supply lines. As the restless dead multiply across Duskwood, she calls on wandering champions to carry the fight into Raven Hill’s depths.

sections.title: Purging the Mausoleum
sections.body: The eastern mausoleum in Raven Hill Cemetery holds one of the region’s largest concentrations of undead. Unlike the open barrows, its stone crypts teem with plague spreaders. These ghouls carry afflictions that can sicken the living. Destroying twenty gives The Night Watch room to breathe and helps keep Darkshire from facing a united undead surge from the west.

faq.q: Why is the Night Watch sending adventurers instead of their own men?
aliases: why the night watch needs help
faq.answer: The Night Watch has too few guards to cover Duskwood. Stormwind sends no official troops, so Commander Althea Ebonlocke can barely hold Darkshire’s edge and watch the roads. No militia remains to enter fortified crypts like Raven Hill.

faq.q: Where is the eastern mausoleum located?
faq.answer: The eastern mausoleum lies in the eastern part of Raven Hill Cemetery, in northwestern Duskwood. Its entrance opens into stone crypts where plague spreaders gather.

faq.q: What makes the plague spreaders dangerous?
faq.answer: Plague spreaders are ravenous ghouls that carry virulent decay. Their corruption could spread beyond the cemetery and taint Darkshire’s surviving residents.
Althea Ebonlocke commands The Night Watch and is related to Darkshire’s mayor, Lord Ello Ebonlocke. She directs Duskwood’s defense from inside Darkshire.

faq.q: Does completing this chain end the undead threat in Duskwood?
faq.answer: No. Thinning the mausoleum’s ranks eases the immediate pressure on Darkshire, but Raven Hill remains infested. Darker powers across Duskwood still stir the dead.

faq.q: How does this fit into the Night Watch questline?
aliases: is this the last night watch quest
faq.answer: This is the third and final chapter in Commander Ebonlocke’s direct martial campaign for The Night Watch. The fight moves from the open roads to the graveyard’s outskirts, then deep into the mausoleum.

angles.text: With Stormwind’s crown ignoring Duskwood’s pleas, Alliance champions must step forward to save loyal citizens from the undead.
As a paladin, you face a profane mockery of sacred burial rites in Raven Hill’s plague-ridden vaults. Cleansing the crypts is a vital duty to the Holy Light.
As a priest, you face the vile contagion spread by ghouls in the eastern mausoleum. The threat calls for cleansing in spirit and body.
